evidence: src/requests/adapters.py:102-105 -- client_cert paths are put into pool kwargs as cert_file and key_file; urllib3's ssl_wrap_socket loads a supplied cert_file/key_file into the provided SSLContext with load_cert_chain().
findings.suggested_fix: Avoid using the shared default SSLContext for pools with client certificates; use a context isolated by client certificate (or an equivalent per-connection mechanism) while keeping the default CA bundle preloaded.
findings.title: Client certificate persists on the shared TLS context

findings.suggested_fix: Track the default bundle's version or modification state and replace the cached SSLContext after it changes, so new connections use the current roots.
findings.title: CWE-295: Cached context ignores CA bundle updates

testing_gaps: The new verify=True path passes a preloaded context (src/requests/adapters.py:94-95), but the existing default-verification test only asserts that an untrusted local certificate fails (tests/test_requests.py:1019-1026). A context with no trusted roots would satisfy that negative test while breaking HTTPS to publicly trusted servers; add a positive test proving a default-trusted chain succeeds.

The new custom-CA path distinguishes a CA directory from a bundle file (src/requests/adapters.py:96-100), but existing custom-CA coverage uses files only (tests/test_requests.py:2897-2924). Add coverage that a CA directory successfully verifies a server signed by a CA in that directory.
